::: {.home}

## About this course

Welcome to **Nexellence INQUIRE** — Integrated Research Methods & Data Science. Over three weeks and fifteen full-day sessions, you'll work as a junior researcher: asking questions, designing studies, analyzing data, and presenting real research at the final Research Summit.

Each full day runs in two blocks: a **morning ResearchCORE** session (research methods) and an **afternoon DataCORE** session (data science). The schedule below lists both, each linking to its slides in HTML and PDF.

::: {.schedule-page}
